map_openai_params: map OpenAI TTS parameters to ElevenLabs TTS parameters including voice, format, and speed
transform_text_to_speech_request: build the ElevenLabs TTS request payload from input text, model, and optional parameters
get_complete_url: construct the ElevenLabs text-to-speech endpoint URL with voice ID and query parameters
validate_environment: validate ElevenLabs API key and set up authentication headers for the TTS request
transform_text_to_speech_response: wrap the ElevenLabs binary audio response into an HttpxBinaryResponseContent object
